title: Introduction of the Side-by-Side package and amendments to Multinational Top-up Tax and Domestic Top-up Tax
text:
This measure implements the Side-by-Side package into UK legislation in line with the guidance published by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) in January 2026.

 It also makes amendments to Multinational Top-up Tax and Domestic Top-up Tax to make sure UK legislation remains consistent with the commentary and guidance developed by the UK and other members of the Inclusive Framework.
